The '''Utor system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Utor Shock]], a conflict in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] had a key role in that took place in [[602 BBY]], took place in the vicinity of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Utor system was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed in in grid square L-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
